##### <a name="-openbao--mode"></a>`mode`

Data type: `Enum['server', 'agent']`

Whether to run OpenBao as a `server` or as an `agent`. This selects both the
generated configuration layout and the subcommand used by the systemd unit.

Default value: `'server'`

##### <a name="-openbao--version"></a>`version`

Data type: `Pattern[/\A\d+\.\d+\.\d+(-[0-9A-Za-z.-]+)?\z/]`

Version of OpenBao to install, as upstream numbers its releases and without the `v`
the tags carry. Builds the download URL of `install_method => 'archive'`, and drives
its upgrades through the `openbao_version` fact. A pre-release suffix is accepted and
counts as older than the final release of the same number.

Default value: `'2.6.1'`

##### <a name="-openbao--user"></a>`user`

Data type: `String[1]`

User the OpenBao process runs as.

Default value: `'openbao'`

##### <a name="-openbao--manage_user"></a>`manage_user`

Data type: `Boolean`

Whether this module should create `user`. Note that the official packages already
create the `openbao` user in their `preinst` script.

Default value: `true`

##### <a name="-openbao--group"></a>`group`

Data type: `String[1]`

Group the OpenBao process runs as.

Default value: `'openbao'`

##### <a name="-openbao--manage_group"></a>`manage_group`

Data type: `Boolean`

Whether this module should create `group`.

Default value: `true`

##### <a name="-openbao--install_method"></a>`install_method`

Data type: `Enum['repo', 'archive']`

How to install OpenBao. `repo` installs the `openbao` package from the official
OpenBao package repositories (see `openbao::repo`), `archive` downloads the release
tarball from GitHub and extracts the `bao` binary into `bin_dir`.

Default value: `'repo'`

##### <a name="-openbao--manage_package"></a>`manage_package`

Data type: `Boolean`

Whether this module installs OpenBao at all. Set to `false` when the binary is
provided by other means; `openbao::install` then only manages the user and group.

Default value: `true`

##### <a name="-openbao--package_name"></a>`package_name`

Data type: `String[1]`

Name of the package to install. Use `openbao-hsm` for the HSM/PKCS#11 flavour.

Default value: `'openbao'`

##### <a name="-openbao--package_ensure"></a>`package_ensure`

Data type: `String[1]`

`ensure` value for the package. Set it to a version string (for example `2.6.1`) to
pin a release; the repository keeps every published version.

Default value: `'installed'`

##### <a name="-openbao--bin_dir"></a>`bin_dir`

Data type: `Stdlib::Absolutepath`

Directory holding the OpenBao binary. Defaults to `/usr/local/bin` for archive
installs and to `/usr/bin` (where the packages put it) otherwise.

Default value:

```puppet
$install_method ? {
    'archive' => '/usr/local/bin',
    default   => '/usr/bin'
```

##### <a name="-openbao--bin_name"></a>`bin_name`

Data type: `String[1]`

Name of the OpenBao binary. `install_method => 'archive'` extracts the `bao` member
of the upstream tarball and therefore requires the default.

Default value: `'bao'`

##### <a name="-openbao--manage_repo"></a>`manage_repo`

Data type: `Boolean`

Whether to configure the official OpenBao package repository, through the
`openbao::repo` class, whose own parameters tune it. Only relevant when
`install_method` is `repo`.

Default value: `true`

##### <a name="-openbao--download_url"></a>`download_url`

Data type: `Optional[Stdlib::HTTPUrl]`

Full URL of the release archive, overriding the URL computed from `version`.

Default value: `undef`

##### <a name="-openbao--download_url_base"></a>`download_url_base`

Data type: `Stdlib::HTTPUrl`

Base URL the release archive is downloaded from.

Default value: `'https://github.com/openbao/openbao/releases/download/'`

##### <a name="-openbao--download_checksum"></a>`download_checksum`

Data type: `Optional[String[1]]`

Checksum of the release archive, verified after the download, and `undef` to skip the
verification. Copy it from the `openbao_<version>_<os>_<arch>.tar.gz` line of the
`checksums.txt` upstream publishes per release — it therefore assumes a pinned
`version`, and a value per architecture on a mixed estate.

Default value: `undef`

##### <a name="-openbao--download_checksum_type"></a>`download_checksum_type`

Data type: `Enum['sha256', 'sha512']`

Digest `download_checksum` is expressed in.

Default value: `'sha256'`

##### <a name="-openbao--download_extension"></a>`download_extension`

Data type: `Enum['tar.gz', 'tgz']`

Extension of the release archive. Only `tar.gz` and `tgz` are accepted — what
upstream publishes; zip is refused because `unzip` cannot replace a running binary
on upgrades.

Default value: `'tar.gz'`

##### <a name="-openbao--download_dir"></a>`download_dir`

Data type: `Stdlib::Absolutepath`

Directory the release archive is downloaded into.

Default value: `'/tmp'`

##### <a name="-openbao--manage_download_dir"></a>`manage_download_dir`

Data type: `Boolean`

Whether to create `download_dir`.

Default value: `false`

##### <a name="-openbao--os"></a>`os`

Data type: `String[1]`

Operating system part of the release archive name. Derived from the `kernel` fact.

Default value: `downcase($facts['kernel'])`

##### <a name="-openbao--manage_file_capabilities"></a>`manage_file_capabilities`

Data type: `Boolean`

Whether to grant `cap_ipc_lock=ep` to the binary so that OpenBao can `mlock` its
memory, which pulls in the `file_capability` class for `setcap`. On by default for
managed archive installs only, and ignored when `disable_mlock` is true.

Default value: `($manage_package and $install_method == 'archive'`

##### <a name="-openbao--config_format"></a>`config_format`

Data type: `Enum['hcl', 'json']`

Format of the generated configuration file, `hcl` or `json`. Both are understood by
OpenBao; `json` is a safe choice for deeply nested or unusual structures.

Default value: `'hcl'`

##### <a name="-openbao--config_dir"></a>`config_dir`

Data type: `Stdlib::Absolutepath`

Directory holding the OpenBao configuration.

Default value: `'/etc/openbao'`

##### <a name="-openbao--config_filename"></a>`config_filename`

Data type: `String[1]`

Name of the generated configuration file.

Default value: `"openbao.${config_format}"`

##### <a name="-openbao--config_mode"></a>`config_mode`

Data type: `Stdlib::Filemode`

Mode of the generated configuration file.

Default value: `'0640'`

##### <a name="-openbao--manage_config_dir"></a>`manage_config_dir`

Data type: `Boolean`

Whether to manage `config_dir`.

Default value: `true`

##### <a name="-openbao--manage_config_file"></a>`manage_config_file`

Data type: `Boolean`

Whether to generate the configuration file.

Default value: `true`

##### <a name="-openbao--purge_config_dir"></a>`purge_config_dir`

Data type: `Boolean`

Whether to remove unmanaged files from `config_dir`. Off by default: the packages
ship files there. Purging implies recursion, which applies the directory owner, group
and mode to every file below, so keep TLS material outside of `config_dir`.

Default value: `false`

##### <a name="-openbao--extra_config"></a>`extra_config`

Data type: `Hash`

Additional configuration, for stanzas this module does not expose as a parameter. The
merge is top level only: a key of the same name replaces the generated stanza
outright instead of adding to it, so restate the whole stanza.

Default value: `{}`

##### <a name="-openbao--raw_config"></a>`raw_config`

Data type: `Optional[String[1]]`

Raw configuration appended verbatim at the end of the file. Only allowed with
`config_format => 'hcl'` (it would corrupt a JSON file), for constructs the HCL
renderer cannot express (such as the two-label `plugin "secret" "aws" {}` block).

Default value: `undef`

##### <a name="-openbao--manage_environment_file"></a>`manage_environment_file`

Data type: `Boolean`

Whether to manage the environment file read by the systemd unit.

Default value: `true`

##### <a name="-openbao--environment_file"></a>`environment_file`

Data type: `Stdlib::Absolutepath`

Path of the environment file.

Default value: `"${config_dir}/openbao.env"`

##### <a name="-openbao--environment_variables"></a>`environment_variables`

Data type: `Hash[String[1], Variant[String, Integer, Boolean, Sensitive[String]]]`

Variables written to `environment_file`, for `BAO_*` settings or the credentials of an
auto-unseal backend — hence values may be `Sensitive`, and are unwrapped on the way to
the file. They are double-quoted there; newlines are refused.

Default value: `{}`

##### <a name="-openbao--listener"></a>`listener`

Data type: `Variant[Hash, Array[Hash]]`

Server mode. `listener` stanza(s). A Hash is a single listener keyed by its type, an
Array of Hashes declares several of them.

Default value:

```puppet
{
    'tcp' => { 'address' => '127.0.0.1:8200', 'tls_disable' => true },
  }
```

##### <a name="-openbao--storage"></a>`storage`

Data type: `Hash`

Server mode. `storage` stanza, keyed by backend type.

Default value:

```puppet

    'file' => { 'path' => '/var/lib/openbao' },

```

Server mode. Whether to create the directory referenced by the `file` or `raft`
storage backend. The parent directory must already exist. Backends that keep no

Default value: `true`

##### <a name="-openbao--restart_on_change"></a>`restart_on_change`

Data type: `Boolean`

Whether a changed configuration, environment file, systemd unit or binary restarts the
service. On by default; set it to `false` on servers without auto-unseal, where a
restart leaves OpenBao sealed until an operator unseals it.

Default value: `true`

##### <a name="-openbao--service_ensure"></a>`service_ensure`

Data type: `Stdlib::Ensure::Service`

Desired state of the service.

Default value: `'running'`

##### <a name="-openbao--service_enable"></a>`service_enable`

Data type: `Boolean`

Whether the service starts at boot.

Default value: `true`

##### <a name="-openbao--service_provider"></a>`service_provider`

Data type: `Optional[String[1]]`

Service provider to use.

Default value: `$facts['service_provider']`

##### <a name="-openbao--manage_service_file"></a>`manage_service_file`

Data type: `Boolean`

Whether to write the systemd unit, in `/etc/systemd/system` where it takes precedence
over the packaged one. On by default: the packaged unit hardcodes
`bao server -config=/etc/openbao/openbao.hcl`, wrong in agent mode and on any other
configuration path.

Default value: `true`

##### <a name="-openbao--service_options"></a>`service_options`

Data type: `Optional[String[1]]`

Extra command line arguments appended to `bao <mode>`.

Default value: `undef`

##### <a name="-openbao--service_read_write_paths"></a>`service_read_write_paths`

Data type: `Array[Stdlib::Absolutepath]`

Paths added to the `ReadWritePaths=` directive of the unit, needed for anything
OpenBao writes outside of `/run/<service_name>` and the storage directory — agent
template destinations in particular, `ProtectSystem=full` mounting `/etc` read-only.

Default value: `[]`

##### <a name="-openbao--num_procs"></a>`num_procs`

Data type: `Integer[1]`

Value of `GOMAXPROCS` in the unit, limiting how many CPUs OpenBao uses.

Default value: `pick($facts.dig('processors', 'count'), 1)`

### <a name="openbao--repo"></a>`openbao::repo`

The repositories are the ones advertised on https://openbao.org/downloads. No signing
key is shipped with this module: by default both APT and YUM are pointed at the key
published by OpenBao and fetch it themselves.

The class stands on its own, so the repository can be configured without letting the
`openbao` class manage the service.

#### Parameters

The following parameters are available in the `openbao::repo` class:

* [`base_url`](#-openbao--repo--base_url)
* [`release`](#-openbao--repo--release)
* [`component`](#-openbao--repo--component)
* [`rpm_path`](#-openbao--repo--rpm_path)

##### <a name="-openbao--repo--base_url"></a>`base_url`

Data type: `Stdlib::HTTPUrl`

Base URL of the OpenBao package repositories.

Default value: `'https://pkgs.openbao.org'`

##### <a name="-openbao--repo--release"></a>`release`

Data type: `String[1]`

APT suite to use. `stable` for releases, `testing` for pre-releases.

Default value: `'stable'`

##### <a name="-openbao--repo--component"></a>`component`

Data type: `String[1]`

APT component to use.

Default value: `'main'`

##### <a name="-openbao--repo--rpm_path"></a>`rpm_path`

Data type: `String[1]`

Path component of the RPM repository. `rpm` for releases, `rpm-testing` for
pre-releases.

Default value: `'rpm'`

##### <a name="-openbao--repo--description"></a>`description`

Data type: `String[1]`

Human readable description of the repository.

Default value: `'OpenBao package repository'`

##### <a name="-openbao--repo--architecture"></a>`architecture`

Data type: `Optional[Array[String[1], 1]]`

Architectures to restrict the APT source to. Left to APT by default.

Default value: `undef`

##### <a name="-openbao--repo--enabled"></a>`enabled`

Data type: `Boolean`

Whether the repository is enabled.

Default value: `true`

##### <a name="-openbao--repo--apt_pin_priority"></a>`apt_pin_priority`

Data type: `Integer`

APT pin priority of the repository, written to `/etc/apt/preferences.d`. The highest
value wins, over a default of 500 for every available version, and 1000 is the
threshold above which APT also downgrades.

Default value: `900`

##### <a name="-openbao--repo--yum_priority"></a>`yum_priority`

Data type: `Integer[1, 99]`

Priority of the yum repository, written as a `priority` option in its `.repo` file.
The *lowest* value wins, on a 1-99 scale where every other repository sits at 99, and
same-named packages from the losing repositories are excluded outright.

Default value: `10`

##### <a name="-openbao--repo--pin_originator"></a>`pin_originator`

Data type: `String[1]`

`Origin` value the APT pin matches. The default matches the Release file of the
official repository; override it together with `base_url` when pinning a mirror that
publishes a different `Origin`.

Default value: `'OpenBao - Official'`

##### <a name="-openbao--repo--metadata_expire"></a>`metadata_expire`

Data type: `String[1]`

How long dnf considers the repository metadata fresh, in seconds. The default keeps
newly published releases visible quickly; raise it for slow or rate limited
mirrors. YUM only.

Default value: `'300'`

##### <a name="-openbao--repo--proxy"></a>`proxy`

Data type: `Optional[Stdlib::HTTPUrl]`

HTTP proxy used to reach the repository. YUM only.

Default value: `undef`

##### <a name="-openbao--repo--sslcacert"></a>`sslcacert`

Data type: `Optional[Stdlib::Absolutepath]`

Certificate authority dnf verifies the repository host against, for a mirror served
with a private CA. The file is expected to be deployed by other means. YUM only: APT
reads the system trust store.

Default value: `undef`

##### <a name="-openbao--repo--manage_gpgkey"></a>`manage_gpgkey`

Data type: `Boolean`

Whether this module deploys the signing key of the repository. With `false` the key is
expected from elsewhere and verification stays on, so installs fail until it is there.
To skip verification instead, see `allow_unsigned`.

Default value: `true`

##### <a name="-openbao--repo--allow_unsigned"></a>`allow_unsigned`

Data type: `Boolean`

Whether to accept packages without a valid signature (`Trusted: yes` on Debian,
`gpgcheck=0` on RedHat). Opting out of the chain of trust lets anyone able to tamper
with the transport install packages as root. Last resort only.

Default value: `false`

##### <a name="-openbao--repo--gpgkey_source"></a>`gpgkey_source`

Data type: `Stdlib::Filesource`

Where to fetch the signing key from, as anything `Stdlib::Filesource` allows — an
internal mirror URL or a `puppet:///` source included. Ignored when `gpgkey_content`
is set.

Default value: `'https://openbao.org/assets/openbao-gpg-pub-20240618.asc'`

##### <a name="-openbao--repo--gpgkey_content"></a>`gpgkey_content`

Data type: `Optional[String[1]]`

The ASCII armoured signing key itself, for hosts that cannot reach the key server.
Takes precedence over `gpgkey_source`.

Default value: `undef`

##### <a name="-openbao--repo--keyring_path"></a>`keyring_path`

Data type: `Stdlib::Absolutepath`

Where the signing key is written: the keyring referenced by `Signed-By:` on Debian,
and on RedHat a path only used for keys that are not an `http(s)` URL, dnf fetching
those itself.

Default value: `'/etc/openbao-keyring.asc'`

## Functions

### <a name="openbao--compact"></a>`openbao::compact`

Type: Ruby 4.x API

`delete_undef_values` and the `skip_undef` argument of `stdlib::to_json_pretty` only
look at the top level, leaving nested `null` values that OpenBao refuses to start on.

Sensitive values are unwrapped along the way, both renderers writing the literal
"Sensitive [value redacted]" placeholder otherwise.

#### `openbao::compact(Variant[Hash, Array] $data)`

`delete_undef_values` and the `skip_undef` argument of `stdlib::to_json_pretty` only
look at the top level, leaving nested `null` values that OpenBao refuses to start on.

Sensitive values are unwrapped along the way, both renderers writing the literal
"Sensitive [value redacted]" placeholder otherwise.

Returns: `Variant[Hash, Array]` the same structure without any undef value.

##### `data`

Data type: `Variant[Hash, Array]`

The data structure to clean up.

### <a name="openbao--to_hcl"></a>`openbao::to_hcl`

Type: Ruby 4.x API

Values are mapped as follows:

* a scalar, or an Array of scalars, becomes an `key = value` attribute;
* a Hash becomes a `key { ... }` block;
* a Hash under one of the labelled keys (`listener`, `storage`, ...) becomes a
  `key "label" { ... }` block, the single key of the Hash being the label;
* an Array of Hashes repeats the block.

Blocks carrying two labels, such as `plugin "secret" "aws" {}`, cannot be expressed
this way; use the `raw_config` parameter of the `openbao` class for those.

#### `openbao::to_hcl(Hash $config)`

Values are mapped as follows:

* a scalar, or an Array of scalars, becomes an `key = value` attribute;
* a Hash becomes a `key { ... }` block;
* a Hash under one of the labelled keys (`listener`, `storage`, ...) becomes a
  `key "label" { ... }` block, the single key of the Hash being the label;
* an Array of Hashes repeats the block.

Blocks carrying two labels, such as `plugin "secret" "aws" {}`, cannot be expressed
this way; use the `raw_config` parameter of the `openbao` class for those.

Returns: `String` the HCL document.

##### `config`

Data type: `Hash`

The configuration to render.
